title: Girya
description: You can now gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. ([blue]3[/blue] times max)
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Each time you Lift at a rest site (up to 3 times), you gain 1 Strength for the next combat. When entering a combat room with accumulated Strength stacks, this relic flashes and applies all stacked Strength to your character. Not available in Act 3.
